home.hero_desc: AI-powered early warning and extension support for small and marginal farmers in Maharashtra.
home.crop_risk_desc: Weather and location-based early warning. Know your pest and disease risk before damage occurs.
home.detection_desc: AI-assisted image analysis. Upload a leaf photo to identify possible diseases.
home.officer_desc: Human verification and geographic monitoring. Agriculture officers review and verify field reports.
home.journey_subtitle: A simple 5-step flow from field observation to expert support.
home.step3: Check crop risk or upload leaf photo
home.step4: Get AI-assisted result in your language
home.transparency_1: AI results are assistive — not a confirmed diagnosis.
home.transparency_2: Always consult your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) for confirmation.
home.transparency_3: Risk scores indicate early warning probability, not confirmed disease presence.
home.transparency_4: Low-confidence AI results are automatically flagged for officer review.
home.detect_next: Upload leaf photo for AI-assisted detection →
home.detect_unsupported: Image detection not available for this crop. Use Crop Risk and consult an extension officer.
